projects.title: StockGenie
projects.description: Laravel 11 inventory, POS and back office system. Covers products, orders, customers, suppliers, employees, attendance and expenses, with PDF reports.

caseStudyData.lead: A Laravel 11 system that puts stock, sales, customers, suppliers, staff and expenses in one admin panel for a small business.

sections.title: The problem
paragraphs: A small shop usually tracks stock in one place, sales in another and expenses in a notebook. Totals stop matching.
StockGenie keeps products, orders and stock levels in one database so a sale reduces stock immediately.

sections.title: Main modules
paragraphs: The v2.0 codebase has 15 Eloquent models, 20 migrations, 33 controllers and 73 Blade views.

cards.title: Inventory
cards.description: Products, categories, stock levels and a product history table for stock changes.

cards.title: POS checkout
cards.description: Cart based sales that write order lines and update stock.

cards.title: Back office
cards.description: Customers, suppliers, employees, attendance and expenses.

cards.title: Reports and tables
cards.description: PDF reports through dompdf and searchable DataTables lists.

sections.title: What is not covered
paragraphs: The system is built for a single user. It has no multi user permissions and no online payments.
Automated tests are limited to the default Laravel Breeze authentication and profile tests.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Laravel store with an admin panel. Covers products, categories, orders, low stock alerts and role based access.

caseStudyData.lead: A Laravel online store where customers place orders and one admin manages products, stock and order status.

sections.title: The problem
paragraphs: A small online store needs product management, stock visibility and an order process that one person can run.
The app splits the customer side from the admin side and protects admin pages with roles.

sections.title: Main modules
paragraphs: The codebase has 10 models, 14 migrations, 20 controllers, 59 Blade views and 53 routes.

cards.title: Catalog
cards.description: Create, edit and delete products, categories and subcategories.

cards.title: Stock alerts
cards.description: Dashboard shows sales totals and flags products with fewer than 5 units.

cards.title: Orders
cards.description: Customers place orders. The admin completes or cancels them.

cards.title: Access control
cards.description: Laravel Breeze for login and Laratrust for roles and permissions.

sections.title: What is not covered
paragraphs: Payments are handled manually. There is no payment gateway.
The repository has no feature tests beyond the Laravel base test case.

projects.title: Hospital Management System
projects.description: Multi page hospital website with separate admin and doctor areas, built with HTML, CSS and PHP.

caseStudyData.lead: An early multi page hospital site with separate admin and doctor sections.

sections.title: The problem
paragraphs: Hospital sites serve patients, doctors and administrators. Each group needs its own pages and a shared navigation.

sections.title: Main parts
paragraphs: The repository holds about 16 PHP files, 14 HTML pages, 3 CSS files and one JavaScript file.

cards.title: Public pages
cards.description: Service and department information with consistent navigation.

cards.title: Doctor area
cards.description: Separate pages for doctor facing information.

sections.title: What is not covered
paragraphs: This is an early project from 2022 to 2023. It does not use a framework, a tested backend or a full database layer.
